sentences.en: The picture is presumed to have been painted by Picasso.
sentences.zh: 这幅画被认为是毕加索所作。

sentences.en: May I presume to tell you that you are wrong?
sentences.zh: 我可以冒昧地告诉你你错了吗？

sentences.en: From the way they talked, I presumed they were married.
sentences.zh: 从他们的谈话方式来看，我推测他们是已婚的。

senses.zh: 以为，认为；假定，假设；推测
